```{r}
source("scripts/build_seminar_data.R")
```

This page summarises the geographic reach and participation of the [Bioconductor Africa Seminar Series](https://training.bioconductor.org/seminars/bioc-africa/). The series supports the growth of the Bioconductor community in Africa while remaining open to participants worldwide.

**Sessions to date:** `r total_sessions`  
**Topics covered:** `r total_topics`  
**Last updated:** `r generated_on`

# Series registrations

These maps show approved registrants across all available registration reports, deduplicated by email address. Someone who registered for more than one topic, or for a recurring meeting with several sessions, is counted once.

**Unique registrants:** `r total_unique_registrants`  
**Registrants represented on the map:** `r mapped_unique_registrants`

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Africa focus

```{r}
interactive_map_registrants_africa
```

## Global view

```{r}
interactive_map_registrants_global
```

:::

# Series attendance

These maps show identifiable audience attendees across all available sessions, deduplicated by email address. Community attendance measures exclude the organising team and known automated AI notetakers.

Unique and repeat-attendance measures include attendees who could be matched consistently by email address. A small number of attendees without a consistent identifier are excluded from these measures.

**Unique identifiable audience attendees:** `r total_unique_audience_attendees`  
**Attendees with country information:** `r mapped_unique_audience_attendees`  
**Attended two or more sessions:** `r total_repeat_session_attendees` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", repeat_session_percentage)` of identifiable attendees)  
**Attended two or more topics:** `r total_cross_topic_attendees` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", cross_topic_percentage)` of identifiable attendees)

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Africa focus

```{r}
interactive_map_attendance_africa
```

## Global view

```{r}
interactive_map_attendance_global
```

:::

```{r}
if (nrow(recurring_topic_engagement) > 0) {
  recurring_summary <- recurring_topic_engagement %>%
    transmute(
      `Recurring topic` = seminar_title,
      Sessions = occurrence_total,
      `Attended two or more sessions` = attendees_two_or_more,
      `Attended all sessions` = attendees_all_sessions
    )

  knitr::kable(
    recurring_summary,
    caption = "Engagement within recurring topic series"
  )
}
```

# Attendance by session

Attendance is deduplicated within each session. Known AI notetakers and the host are excluded from session totals. Where country was not collected, available country information is matched by email address from registrations for other seminars.

For recurring meetings, **registered by this session** is the cumulative number registered by the end of that session.

```{r}
seminar_summary <- seminar_data %>%
  transmute(
    Seminar = seminar_display_title,
    Date = format(file_date, "%d %B %Y"),
    `Registrations by session date` = total_registrants,
    Attendees = total_attendees,
    `Attendees represented on map` = attendees_mapped
  )

knitr::kable(seminar_summary)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis

for (i in rev(seq_len(nrow(seminar_data)))) {
  seminar <- seminar_data[i, ]

  notes <- character()

  if (!seminar$country_collected) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste(
        "Country was not collected for this registration form.",
        "Where possible, locations were matched by email address",
        "from registrations for other seminars."
      )
    )
  }

  note_text <- if (length(notes) > 0) {
    paste0(
      "\n\n",
      paste(notes, collapse = " "),
      "\n\n"
    )
  } else {
    "\n\n"
  }

  child_text <- paste0(
    "\n## ", seminar$seminar_display_title, "\n\n",
    format(seminar$file_date, "%d %B %Y"), "\n\n",
    "**Registered by this session:** ", seminar$total_registrants, "  \n",
    "**Attendees:** ", seminar$total_attendees, "  \n",
    "**Represented on the map:** ", seminar$attendees_mapped,
    note_text,
    "### Attendees by country\n\n",
    "```{r seminar-", i, "-africa}\n",
    "seminar_data$map_africa[[", i, "]]\n",
    "```\n"
  )

  cat(
    knitr::knit_child(
      text = child_text,
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```
